title: Farm & Charm x Regions Unexplored compat
description: Adds Regions Unexplored farmlands support to Farm & Charm
body:
# Farm & Charm x Regions Unexplored compat
Both Forge and Fabric versions of Regions Unexplored overwrite their farmlands' methods in a way that breaks Regions Unexplored compatibility. This mod fixes that since the 1.20.1 version is now abandoned

## Current fixes
- RU's farmlands are now hydrated by F&C's sprinklers
- RU's farmland is no longer destroyed by jumping if entity wears F&C's Dungarees

## 1.21.1+?
Most likely not happening. 1.21.1 version of Regions Unexplored is actively maintained, please ask the developer to implement compatibility. If they refuse, please create a github issue or join my discord server and ask me to update my patch
